d: MS Dhoni’s next move to play or retire could have a major bearing on Chennai Super Kings’ plans for IPL 2027. The former CSK captain, who missed the entire 2026 season with a calf injury, is expected to assess his fitness before deciding whether to continue playing. But with CSK finishing eighth this year after ending up last in 2025, the franchise has bigger questions to answer than just Dhoni’s availability. Can Chennai prepare for the future while waiting for its most iconic player to make a call? Rupha Ramani looks at Dhoni’s IPL future, CSK’s succession dilemma and the decisions that…
